newsitem.title: USA: ENCAD shareholder suit is dropped.
newsitem.headline: ENCAD shareholder suit is dropped.

text.p: ENCAD Inc said Wednesday that a shareholder suit filed against the company last year has been dropped by the plaintiffs after a review of the facts and circumstances of the case.
ENCAD said no payment or consideration of any kind was paid by the company.

"We have always believed very strongly that an objective, fair and conscientious review would confirm that ENCAD did not violate the federal securities laws," said ENCAD Chairman and Chief Executive David Purcell. "We are extremely pleased with the dismissal, and that plaintiffs' counsel decided not to pursue the case."
ENCAD manufactures wide-format color inkjet printers, software, inks and media.
